[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John Glasgow was baptized at Kirknewton and East Calder on 18 August 1751. His birth date is unproved; the evidence supports birth on or before that baptism, not an exact birthday. The imported exact date 18 August 1751 is retained here as the earlier profile claim, not as an established birth date. The baptism record names John Glasgow and Christian Meek; the existing adult-household comparison remains 98% proved within its stated scope.

=== Bankhead household evidence ===

The detailed parish transcript of [[Glasgow-3480|John’s]] baptism on 18 August 1751 names his father [[Glasgow-3481|John Glasgow]] as a weaver and gives the residence as Bankhead. His mother is indexed as Christian Meck, corresponding to the existing [[Meek-3817|Christian Meek]] household.<ref>Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4474385&tab=this John Glasgow, baptism 18 August 1751], Kirknewton and East Calder; father John Glasgow, occupation Weaver, residence Bankhead, motherChristian Meck; OPR 689/20 item 1. Detailed derivative transcript inspected 31 October 2026; original uninspected. The displayed register range 1642–1737 conflicts with the event year and awaits catalogue/original checking. Companion indexes R_686207931 and R_691903896 and the MyHeritage citation describe the same event.</ref> Baptism does not establish an exact birth date.

The trade and residence do not prove the father’s childhood or the identification of the 1730 and 1751 adult accounts. Jean’s 1730 transcript names father John without mother, residence or trade; its 20 November reading remains unresolved against the 11 November FamilySearch reading. The 1702 John/William entry provides no occupation or residence. Another father John is indexed as a weaver at Templtand in 1717, but a shared occupation does not identify the men. The 1736 Leith Christian Meck/Meek marriage names Robert Simson as groom and cannot establish this wife’s marriage or parents.<ref>Findmypast detailed OPR transcripts: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4474288&tab=this Jean1730], [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4473915&tab=this John1702], [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4474159&tab=this John1717], and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FMAR%2F1450857%2F2&tab=this Christian Meck and Robert Simson1736]; derivative comparisons, originals uninspected.</ref>
